training_budget.minibatch_rule: Local models sample one tile, clipping requested tokens to that record length; chain control clips to min(requested,tile_tokens,train_tokens). Tail tiles may have fewer tokens and realized local examples are logged.

protocol: Every local variant and optional chain control frozen before DEV/TEST. TEST is never used to choose models or hyperparameters.
